objective_for_doctor:
Age: 29
Sex: Male
Chief Complaint: I have chest pain even at rest, right side of the chest pain, and left side of the chest pain

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

I’m here because I have chest pain even at rest. It’s on both the right and left upper chest, kind of heavy and exhausting, and I’m also sweating a lot and feeling very short of breath. It also goes to my left biceps and shoulders, and I have some epigastric pain too.
[ASK] Do you have **chest pain that is worse with breathing (pleuritic pain)** or **sudden shortness of breath**?
No—my shortness of breath is more like I can’t breathe well with the chest pain, not sudden and it’s not specifically worse when I take a deep breath.
[ASK] Do you have chest pain after vomiting/retching (possible esophageal rupture) or severe pain with swallowing?
No, I don’t have pain after vomiting or retching, and I don’t have severe pain when swallowing.
[ASK] Do you have **fever** (temperature ≥ 38°C) along with your symptoms?
No fever. I haven’t had a temperature of 38°C or higher.
[ASK] Do you have **throat/upper-airway symptoms** such as **stridor, severe trouble breathing, or a barking cough**?
No stridor or barking cough. My breathing feels hard because of the chest pain, but I don’t have those upper-airway symptoms.
[ASK] Do you have severe, one-sided headache attacks with tearing/red eye and/or nasal congestion that come in episodes lasting 15–180 minutes?
No, I don’t have those kind of one-sided headache attacks with tearing or red eye.
[ASK] Do you have chest burning or sour-tasting reflux symptoms (heartburn/regurgitation) that are worse after meals or when lying down?
I do have epigastric pain, but it’s not really like heartburn after meals or worse when lying down.
